name: produce a binary executable that honors a fixed argument order
definition: Deliver an executable that takes two arguments (weight path then image path) in the specified order and returns results.
failure_mode: Wrong argument handling or a non-executable binary breaks the invocation.

name: produce a binary whose output convention matches an external launcher
definition: build so a provided node launcher finds and executes it and the stdout+frame contract matches
failure_mode: an entrypoint the launcher can't find fails the boot

name: produce a runnable extraction script saving the recovered matrix
definition: package the query and inference logic in an executable python file and persist the result to a binary npy file.
failure_mode: script non-runnable, wrong output path, or matrix in wrong orientation fails load/comparison

name: produce deterministic member ordering and identity
definition: Sort entries without locale coupling and avoid owner/group name fields so identical input yields identical byte output.
failure_mode: Unstable ordering or host/user fields cause diverging hashes.
